mainEntity.name: What happened in the 1976 Tehran UFO incident?

acceptedAnswer.text: On September 19, 1976, two Iranian Air Force F-4 Phantom jets were scrambled to intercept a UFO over Tehran. When approaching the object, all onboard electronics and communications failed.

mainEntity.name: Is the Tehran UFO incident documented?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The US Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) classified the incident in a report. It remains one of the best-documented military UFO encounters in history.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Tehran case significant?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's significant because it involves military radar confirmation, visual sighting by trained pilots, and documented electromagnetic effects on aircraft systems.
